patterns.note: The oversized hero text dynamically distorts and transforms into a series of rippling horizontal lines as the user scrolls down the page.
A full-width, edge-to-edge grid layout is used for portfolio items, with images filling the available horizontal space.
There is an extreme contrast in typography, featuring a highly experimental, distorted display font for the hero and small, functional sans-serifs for navigation and project titles.
The design predominantly uses a monochromatic palette of black and white, creating a stark and high-contrast visual experience.

technique_notes: To recreate the hero motion, use a scroll-driven animation library like GSAP ScrollTrigger in conjunction with a custom SVG or canvas animation. The large, stylized text element should be animated to compress, distort, and then morph into a series of horizontally rippling lines as the user scrolls past the initial viewport.

Implement a responsive grid system for the portfolio items where images are full-bleed and reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, likely using a scroll observation library like Intersection Observer or Locomotive Scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: extremely oversized, distorted display text (~10x body) with small, functional sans-serif for navigation and project titles
design_tokens.spacing: airy in the hero, balanced in the portfolio grid

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly experimental and animated hero text, which dynamically transforms into an abstract, wave-like graphic element as the user scrolls, creating a unique and memorable interactive experience that elevates a standard portfolio site.
